lead: A green conformance case can pin the absence of a rule its own record requires, and reads as coverage, not a gap.
body: `an-attribute-is-retrieved-by-the-shape-it-satisfies.nvst` asserted what the compiler did before `rule:attributes/structural-retrieval`'s last paragraph existed in code, so landing it turned the case red. Before landing a rule the acceptance list names, `grep -rn` the `.nvst` corpus for the spelling it will start refusing.
